card.name: Aparição de Aswan
card.summary: Ao causar dano de batalha ao oponente, você pode escolher 1 Armadilha no seu Cemitério e colocá-la no topo do Deck.

textEvidence.text: After this monster itself inflicts positive battle damage to its opponent, its controller may target one Trap in their own graveyard. Decide whether to activate; on acceptance choose the target before the chain resolves. On resolution place only that same card on top of its owner’s Deck, without drawing or shuffling. No cost. Damage in defense position can also qualify. Prevented damage or an invalid graveyard cannot trigger it; a lethal hit ends the duel first.
